hints.title: Knight Move Geometry
hints.text: The knight can move to at most 8 positions with offsets (+-1, +-2) and (+-2, +-1).

hints.title: Warnsdorff Degree Heuristic
hints.text: Always move the knight to the adjacent unvisited cell that has the fewest onward unvisited moves.

hints.title: Grid State Initialization
hints.text: Initialize an m x n board with -1, place move 0 at (r, c), and recursively explore next moves in degree order.

hints.title: Warnsdorff Knight Tour Implementation

complexity.notes: Warnsdorff heuristic achieves virtually linear completion for knight tours on small boards.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Unordered exploration results in factorial branching and rapid timeout.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(m * n) board space and recursion stack.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies Warnsdorff heuristic to pick candidate with minimum onward degrees.
